newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Jasco sells stake to Captall, unit to Macmed.
newsitem.headline: Jasco sells stake to Captall, unit to Macmed.

text.p: South African electronics to healthcare group Jasco Electronics Ltd said on Monday that black empowerment grouping Capital Alliance Bank Ltd (Captall) had bought a 9.1 percent stake in Jasco.

Jasco said that it had been working with the bank for some time ro review Jasco's operations and formulate a forward strategy and it had been decided to cement this working relationship by Captall taking buying into the firm.
No price or further details were provided.
At the same time, Jasco said agreement had been reached with Macmed Health Care Ltd to buy the businesses of those Jasco subsidiaries collectively known as the "scientific group".
Again no price or other details for this transaction was given.

The announcements follow heavy dealings and a sharp rises in Jasco shares on Friday on speculation that a deal was immiment. By lunchtime on Friday the share had jumped 15.04 percent, or 34 cents, to 260 cents in volume of over 580,000 shares worth 1.5 million rand.
Jasco shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
In a separate announcement Macmed shareholders were also advised to show caution in their sharedealings.
